gaps.sentence: I'd prefer ___ at home rather than go out.
gaps.explanation: would prefer + to-infinitive: I'd prefer to eat. (prefer + -ing for general likes.)

gaps.sentence: If you keep ___ like this, you'll exhaust yourself.
gaps.explanation: keep (+ on) is followed by -ing: keep working.

gaps.sentence: We had better ___ the terms carefully before signing anything.
gaps.explanation: 'Had better' is followed by the infinitive without 'to'.

gaps.sentence: They've postponed ___ the new bridge until spring.
They don't allow ___ in the museum.
gaps.hint: allow + noun / allow sb to do
gaps.explanation: allow + noun/-ing (no personal object): they don't allow photography. With a person: allow visitors to photograph.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
She insisted on ___ for the meal herself.
